Built for the customer holding a phone.

Most local business sites are desktop brochures shrunk down. Mine are built phone-first — because that's where your customers decide: in the parking lot, on the couch, on the go.

WHAT MAKES THESE SITES STAND OUT

  • Opens instantly on a phone, even on weak signal
  • One tap to call you, get directions, or see your hours
  • Menu, services, and prices readable — no pinching, no zooming
  • Set up to show up on Google when locals search what you do
  • Updates are one text message away — you never touch the code
  • Runs on anything: old phones, slow connections, no app to install

The exact build recipe is the product. What you see above is the what — the how stays in the kitchen.

ABOUT

Built different, on purpose.

It started with MySpace.

In high school, I taught myself my first code there — and I got hooked on a small kind of magic: change one line, and suddenly your page played your favorite song or your favorite video. I've been chasing that feeling ever since.

I left college and kept teaching myself. Wix became my classroom — it's where I learned how websites actually work, piece by piece. Once that clicked, every idea I had got a website. I launched a few of them. Honestly, I just never stopped building.

Eleven-plus years in, AI took everything I'd learned and multiplied it. Now I design and build apps, tools, and websites exactly the way I picture them — at my fingertips, no compromises. The workflow I've built is mine alone, earned through an unreasonable number of hours making the vision actually work.

Perry Digital Solutions is what all of that became — my digital craft, under one name. I want to be different in every way. And the day I'm not, I'll find a new way. I always do.

— Matt Perry

POLICIES

Refunds, plain and simple.

Every project is a fixed, one-time quote that you approve before any work begins. Here's exactly how refunds work — no fine print.

Change of mindOnce your build has started, there's no refund for change-of-mind — and "started" includes the concept and planning phase, not just code. You approved the concept first, and everything from that point is designed and built specifically for you. Custom work can't be resold, repurposed, or put back on a shelf, which is exactly why the deposit and the approval step exist.
Outside our controlNo refund for things outside our control: your hosting going down, your domain expiring, or a third-party service — payments, maps, booking tools, review platforms — breaking, changing its rules, or shutting down. Same goes for platform policy changes, like app store or ad network rules, that affect your site after delivery. We'll always help you work around it and find an alternative, but we can't refund for someone else's outage or decision.
Beyond the quoteAnything beyond the agreed quote gets quoted separately before we touch it. If mid-build you ask for something outside the approved concept — extra pages, new features, more revision rounds than agreed — we'll price it, you'll approve it, and only then does work begin. You'll always know the cost before the work happens. No surprise charges, ever — in either direction.
Before we startDeposits are fully refundable until you approve the concept. Once the concept is approved, the deposit is non-refundable — that approval is the starting gun. The calls, the research, the planning, and your reserved build slot are real work with real calendar time behind them, and the deposit exists to cover exactly that.
If we get it wrongIf what's delivered doesn't match the concept you approved, we'll make it right at no charge. Revisions inside the agreed scope are part of every build — that's not a favor, it's the deal. What "make it right" doesn't cover: new features, redesigned sections, or a new direction you decide on after seeing the finished build. Those fall under "beyond the quote" above, and we'll price them fairly.

POLICIES

Your info stays yours.

This site is a single static page. There's no account system, no tracking pixels, and no analytics watching you click around.

What we collectIf you email for a quote, we receive what you send — your name, your email address, and whatever you tell us about your project. That's the entire list.
What it's forReplying to you. Writing your quote. Delivering your project. Nothing else — your email is never added to a list you didn't ask to join.
What never happensWe don't sell, share, or hand your information to anyone. Your business details stay between us, period.
Client work stays confidentialAnything you share for your project — logins, content, customer info — is treated as confidential and never reused anywhere else.
